title: Multi-LLM Orchestration for High-Quality Code Generation: Exploiting Complementary Model Strengths
abstract: arXiv:2510.01379v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are central to automated code generation, yet most approaches use one model at every stage, from writing code to repairing and optimizing it. LLMs have complementary strengths: their failures do not fully overlap across programming languages, algorithmic categories, and development stages. For example, in Python, the model with the highest code-generation accuracy ranks last at code repair. Using one model to generate code, another to repair it, and a third to refine it can therefore achieve higher correctness and better execution performance than a single model throughout. We propose PerfOrch, a multi-LLM multi-agent system with four agents for categorization, generation, debugging, and refinement. The generation, debugging, and refinement agents select models through a Memory module that ranks candidate LLMs by their measured performance for each stage, programming language, and algorithmic category. translated_title: 面向高质量代码生成的多LLM编排：利用模型互补优势
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）是自动化代码生成的核心，然而大多数方法在从编写代码到修复和优化的每个阶段都只使用单一模型。LLM具有互补的优势：它们在不同编程语言、算法类别和开发阶段上的失败并不完全重叠。例如，在Python中，代码生成准确率最高的模型在代码修复方面却排名最后。因此，使用一个模型生成代码、另一个模型修复代码、第三个模型优化代码，可以比全程使用单一模型获得更高的正确性和更好的执行性能。我们提出了PerfOrch，这是一个多LLM多智能体系统，包含四个分别负责分类、生成、调试和优化的智能体。生成、调试和优化智能体通过一个Memory（记忆）模块来选择模型，该模块根据候选LLM在每个阶段、每种编程语言和每个算法类别上的实测性能对其进行排名。我们……
tldr: 提出PerfOrch多智能体系统，通过Memory模块记录各LLM在不同开发阶段、编程语言和算法类别上的实测性能排名，从而在代码生成、调试和优化的每个环节动态选用最合适的模型，利用模型间互补优势实现比单一模型更高的代码正确性和执行性能。
en_tdlr: PerfOrch, a multi-LLM multi-agent system with a Memory module that ranks candidate LLMs by their measured performance for each stage, programming language, and algorithmic category, dynamically selects different models for code generation, debugging, and refinement, exploiting complementary model strengths to achieve higher correctness and better execution performance than any single model.
